rules.title: Scootradar cache target down
rules.summary: Prometheus cannot scrape the scooter feed cache.
rules.description: The cache's /metrics on scootradar-cache:3001 has been down or missing for 3 minutes. The map keeps answering only while the container runs: check the Coolify application mouc13tsnvylg0v9ee9wp5v5 and https://scooter-data.plhery.com/health.

rules.title: Scootradar serves no scooters
rules.description: The map shows no scooters anywhere and /ready answers 503. Look at the snapshot_feed_failed lines in Loki ({app="scootradar-cache"}): the network, or every operator at once.

rules.title: Scootradar collector stalled
rules.summary: No feed collection has finished for 5 minutes.
rules.description: Every collection, successful or not, updates the snapshot, and each feed is collected every minute. The scheduler is stuck: restart the cache (Coolify application mouc13tsnvylg0v9ee9wp5v5) and report what the logs say.

rules.title: Scootradar feed stopped
rules.expr: (max by (feed, source, provider) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state="expired"}) == 1) and on (feed) (avg_over_time((max by (feed) (scootradar_feed_state{job="scootradar-cache", state=~"ok|failing"}))[7d:5m]) > 0.5)
rules.summary: {{ $labels.feed }} has not been served for 10 minutes.
rules.description: The map says {{ $labels.provider }} is not sharing data where this feed covers. It was served more than half of the last 7 days; dead feeds, and feeds such as Velospot that are fresh only now and then, are not reported (see the dashboard's "Expired, rarely served"). The Sentry issue for the feed in scootradar-cache gives its last error, or says its data aged past the limit without one. Loki: {app="scootradar-cache", event="snapshot_feed_state"} | json | feed="{{ $labels.feed }}".

rules.title: Scootradar feed discovery stale
rules.summary: The feed catalog has not been discovered for 2 hours.
rules.description: Discovery runs hourly and retries every minute on failure; the cache keeps its previous catalog meanwhile, so new systems are missing and retired ones stay. The Sentry discovery issue in scootradar-cache has the error.

rules.title: Scootradar cache restarting
rules.summary: The cache has restarted more than three times in an hour.
rules.description: A deploy restarts it once. More is a crash loop: killed above its 1536 MiB, or a startup failure. Its last logs are in Loki ({app="scootradar-cache"}) and an exception in Sentry's scootradar-cache project.

rules.title: Scootradar cache memory high
rules.summary: The cache has used over 1.3 GB for 15 minutes.
rules.description: The container is limited to 1536 MiB and is killed above it. A catalog that grew, or a leak: compare with the feed count on the dashboard.
